en.headline: British driver arrested after Tai Tam Road crash
en.dek: A 47-year-old man was arrested for drink-driving on Sunday night after his private car struck roadside railings on Tai Tam Road in Stanley.
body: Police said a private car travelling north on Tai Tam Road in Stanley lost control at about 8.22pm on Sunday and struck roadside railings. The 47-year-old British driver suffered an eye injury and was taken conscious to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
Officers at the scene detected alcohol on the driver’s breath. He failed a screening breath test and was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving.
The case was handled as a traffic accident with injury. Police have not released further details of the investigation.

zh.headline: 大潭道私家車撞欄 英籍司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 一輛私家車周日晚上在赤柱大潭道失控撞向路邊欄杆，47歲英籍男司機眼部受傷，酒精呼氣測試不合格後涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。
body: 警方表示，周日晚上約八時二十二分，一輛私家車沿赤柱大潭道北行駛期間懷疑失控，撞向路邊欄杆。47歲英籍男司機眼部受傷，清醒被送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院治理。
到場警員發現司機身上有酒氣，他未能通過酒精呼氣測試，涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。
案件列作交通意外有人受傷。警方未有公布調查的進一步詳情。
